title: OIDC: SASL OAUTHBEARER for IMAP
description: Implement SASL OAUTHBEARER (RFC 7628) in the IMAP auth layer. Client sends base64-encoded OAUTHBEARER initial response containing the OAuth2 access token. Validate token using the same OIDC JWT validation path. Requires TLS (refuse OAUTHBEARER on plaintext connections). Blocked on: stoa-e279bbe7.
